faq: Can any seller build a brand page?
Amazon Stores need a registered brand, while eBay Stores and Etsy shops have their own plans. We check what your account allows first. We cannot get around marketplace eligibility rules.
Do you use my own images?

Yes, please send high resolution brand and product photos. Premium includes designed banners using your images and style. We do not use pictures from other sellers or stock images that misrepresent your products.
Can I edit the page afterwards?
Yes. The pages use the marketplace's builder, which you can open in your own account. Premium includes style notes so new sections look like they belong. Larger edits can be quoted separately.
Does a brand page improve my ranking?
Not directly. It gives shoppers a place to browse, helps your ads land somewhere useful and builds trust. We build it to make the products easy to find, and we do not promise any rise in sales.
